goal: A search that returns the right pages is never reported as a search failure because the subject entity was spelled differently: the collapse detector matches the run's subject by its distinctive core, validates the entity it was given, and the share threshold is measured on the two live sets that broke it.
artifact: Patch to OB1/integrations/research-service/search-quality.ts (+ harness.ts entity plumbing) with tests: unit/number spacing and hyphen normalisation (100Hz = 100 Hz = 100-Hz), core-token matching that drops brand/qualifier words (Dell, audio, VR) so 'OptiPlex 3050' satisfies 'Dell OptiPlex 3050', validation + logging of the KEYWORDIZE entity (empty or not-in-query falls back and is counted), ENTITY_SHARE re-measured against the recorded live sets from dry runs b7e701ef (100 Hz) and 1f2ff740 (OptiPlex); plus a coverage-vs-footer fix so 'needs answered 0 of N' cannot print beside a report that states findings from 12 relevant sources.
audience: The operator reading a deep-research report in Open WebUI, who must be able to trust 'search: DEGRADED' as a statement about the search plane, not about the entity string.
acceptance: The recorded live hit set for '100Hz audio VR motion sickness physiological mechanism' (contains PMC11955832 at rank 1) classifies ok with entity '100Hz audio', '100Hz' and '100 Hz'; today it classifies collapsed onto motion with entityShare 0.00 / 0.15 / 0.45.
The recorded live hit set for 'Dell OptiPlex 3050 thermal management overheating problems' classifies ok with entity 'Dell OptiPlex 3050'; today it collapses onto dell because hits omit the brand.
The six original collapse fixtures (dell, most, the100, capacitor, motherboard, vestibular) still classify collapsed; the two good sets (oomkilled, iphone) still classify ok.
An empty entity and an entity not present in the query are both counted in fetchStats.search (entity_missing / entity_rejected) and visible in the footer; a test supplies each.

ENTITY_SHARE is chosen from a table of measured shares over all recorded sets (good and collapsed) written to the findings sink; the chosen value is not on a measured edge (no recorded set within 0.1 of it).
A live dry run of the 100 Hz query after deploy fetches pages and cites a URL matching pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40128952, pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/PMC11955832 or jstage.jst.go.jp; anything else fails.
For the OptiPlex dry run, the footer's 'needs answered X of N' is consistent with the report body: if the body states a finding for a need, that need is not counted open.
deno test -A in research-service stays green with counts at least 143 passed.
out_of_scope: Source weighting for the Answer block (the Walmart-review headline) - separate item.
Reuse recall of semantically-near but off-subject claims (distance <= 0.55).
Any change to the curator, the engine policy, or the gateway.
